comments.body: Depends on where you work, I work with customers and sometimes I struggle with understanding some of the words, I'm also autistic with auditory processing problems, so it gets even worse. As long as you understand Swiss german, answering in Hochdeutsch shouldn't be a problem, unless if you talk to old people for example, they aren't used to Hochdeutsch much, I live in a small town so it can be harder for me, if you live in a bigger city that's okay then.
comments.author: Desperate-Mistake611
